options.name: list_url
options.description: An URL of the alternative overlays list that defines the overlay to install. This list is fetched and saved under C(${overlay_defs}/${name}.xml), where C(overlay_defs) is read from the Layman's configuration.

options.name: name
options.description: The overlay ID to install, synchronize, or uninstall. Use V(ALL) to sync all of the installed overlays (can be used only when O(state=updated)).

options.name: state
options.description: Whether to install (V(present)), sync (V(updated)), or uninstall (V(absent)) the overlay.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If V(false), SSL certificates are not validated. This should only be set to V(false) when no other option exists.
